name: Autumn Sunset Along the River
dimensions: painting proper max.: H. 22.2 x W. 48.6 cm (8 3/4 x 19 1/8 in.)
summary: Three thatched buildings enclosed by a fence stand before a bamboo grove at the right of the composition. A group of trees with dots of red and orange to indicate the autumn colors occupies the foreground. A river, with a fisherman in a small boat, traverses the left portion of the composition. Rolling hills appear in the background.
